color.note: One dark night-sky look. Each theme is a world of the journey: only the accent changes. In the app the world is set with data-w on <html>.

tokens.name: bg0
tokens.usage: Page ground: the night sky. Also the ink on bright fills (on-acc).

tokens.name: bg1
tokens.usage: Lower part of the sky gradient.

tokens.name: bg2
tokens.usage: Raised dark fills, such as the nav bar.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Glass panel fill: cards, answer options, chips. Always over bg0 with a 6px blur.

tokens.name: panel2
tokens.usage: A slightly stronger glass: ghost buttons, the answer letter.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Panel border.

tokens.name: edge2
tokens.usage: Border of the hero card and other first-in-line panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All main text, on bg0, bg1, bg2 and on panels.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Second-level text: explanations, captions, eyebrows. On bg0 and panels (8:1).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Quiet labels only, 14px and up or bold. About 4:1 on bg0: never for body text.

tokens.name: acc
tokens.usage: The world accent: primary buttons, the current progress dot, tags, focus ring, glows. Text on it uses on-acc.

tokens.name: acc2
tokens.usage: The light end of the primary button gradient (acc2 to acc).

tokens.name: on-acc
tokens.usage: Text and icons on acc and acc2 fills (over 9:1 in every world).

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: World colour: air. World banners, map, element icons.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: World colour: water.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: World colour: earth.

tokens.name: fire
tokens.usage: World colour: fire.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Rewards only: diamonds talk, coins, stars, the champion question, the mistakes notebook, streak combo. Text on gold uses #2e2100.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Boss fights and exam simulations: boss button, boss hero, the sim tile.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Correct answer: option border, feedback box, progress dot, the celebration ring and sticker.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Wrong answer and errors. Always with a word ("התשובה:") or a shake, never colour alone.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Reading passages: the paper card a story is printed on.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper (13:1).

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: The big line of the hero card on the home screen.

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles: days to the exam, streak, missions.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: The name in the HUD at the top of each screen.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Feedback titles, tile titles, small card headings.

styles.name: question
styles.sample: איזה מספר מתאים במקום סימן השאלה?

styles.name: answer
styles.sample: כשסוף סוף הופיעו עננים כהים, הם שמחו מאוד.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: כל טעות נשמרת במחברת וחוזרת אליך אחרי יום.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions and secondary lines, in muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The label above a title, in muted.

tokens.name: gap-dots
tokens.usage: Between progress dots and level dots.

tokens.name: gap-chips
tokens.usage: Between chips and between stacked small cards.

tokens.name: gap-row
tokens.usage: Default gap inside a row (.row).

tokens.name: pad-option
tokens.usage: Inside an answer option.

tokens.name: gap-stack
tokens.usage: Between blocks of a screen (.stack).

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: Inside a card. The side gutter of the screen is the same 16px.

tokens.name: pad-hero
tokens.usage: Inside the hero card.

tokens.name: nav-clearance
tokens.usage: Bottom space so the fixed nav and the quiz footer never cover content.

tokens.name: radius-letter
tokens.usage: The letter square (א ב ג ד) inside an answer option.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, answer options, feedback box, hint box.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and banners (--r in the code).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Arcade tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, the combo badge, the celebration sticker.

tokens.name: press-primary
tokens.usage: The 3D press under a primary button (air world; the app mixes it from acc). On press it drops to 2px and the button moves down 3px.

tokens.name: press-gold
tokens.usage: Under gold buttons (rewards, shop).

tokens.name: press-boss
tokens.usage: Under boss and simulation buttons.

tokens.name: glow-correct
tokens.usage: A correct answer while it celebrates.
